description: DELIBERATELY BROKEN — proves the harness has teeth. A standalone-capture blueprint adds a bare "dropdown" node with no dataSourceType. compileSpec()'s leaf builder (scripts/lib/compile/leaf.mjs) never sets dataSourceType on any field type, so this ALWAYS trips tier2.mjs's T2-DROPDOWN-SOURCE ("missing source fails silently") — a genuine, real Tier 2 finding, not a contrived schema error. This case is expected to FAIL and must keep failing; if it ever starts passing, the harness itself has broken.
